description:
I spent twenty-five years as a fire marshal. My job started after the trucks left — walking through what was left of a house, finding the one thing that started it, and writing it down.

It was almost never something dramatic. It was the dryer vent nobody cleaned, the power strip under the rug, the charger left on the bed, the space heater a foot too close to the curtains. Things every house has.

This channel is what I learned standing in those rooms: what I would never keep in my own house, what I check every season, and the habits that decide whether a small fire stays small.

No sponsors. Nothing to sell you.

New videos every week.
